item.title: Spanish PM Sanchez faces EU criticism over Ceuta migration crisis
item.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's migration policies came under sharp criticism as EU leaders met Tuesday following last week's migrant surge in Ceuta.

item.title: Senate panel endorses Blanche for attorney general
item.description: The Senate Judiciary Committee approved Todd Blanche for attorney general on Tuesday, despite strong opposition from Democrats.

item.title: Understanding the Ceuta Crisis
item.description: Migrant surges are driven by incentives, real or perceived, making such events predictable.
